Configure nested Tesseract and PaddleOCR settings in a multi-backend pipeline

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract, ExtractInput, ExtractInputKind
from xberg._xberg import ExtractionConfig

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput(kind=ExtractInputKind("uri"), mime_type="text/plain", uri="https://example.com/text/report.txt")
    config = ExtractionConfig.from_json("{\"ocr\":{\"enabled\":false,\"pipeline\":{\"quality_thresholds\":{},\"stages\":[{\"backend\":\"tesseract\",\"priority\":100,\"tesseract_config\":{\"enable_table_detection\":false,\"psm\":6}},{\"backend\":\"paddleocr\",\"paddle_ocr_settings\":{\"enable_table_detection\":true,\"model_tier\":\"server\",\"use_angle_cls\":true},\"priority\":90}]}}}")
    result = await extract(input, config)
    print(result.results[0].mime_type)
    print(result.results[0].content)

asyncio.run(main())
```
